stories.title: PM says it is 'clear' Russia interfered with Brexit vote
stories.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham said he was given a clear answer on entering No. 10 that Russia interfered in the 2016 referendum, but disclosed no further detail about the alleged activity or who provided the answer. The BBC page showed the report as published about 47 minutes before retrieval, placing it inside the specified window.
